page.notes: The page is a printed index, so every line is an entry with its page references. The left and right columns are read in sequence, as the layout describes. The entries are set in a narrow, damaged type; the upper left and the fold area are faded, but every line here is read clearly. Where the printed "s" appears it is transcribed as plain s. "Letanijs" is transcribed as "Letaniis" (j as i). Two entries run across the column gutter and are kept on one line, as printed.
